meta.title: Technical SEO Audit Tool · SeeO
meta.description: Run a technical SEO audit with SeeO: crawl your site, execute 20+ technical checks, and get a health score with prioritized fixes. Quick single-page checks and full-site audits.

seoAudit.title: Technical SEO Audit
seoAudit.subtitle: Crawl your website, run technical checks page by page, and know exactly what to fix first — ranked by score and priority
seoAudit.whatItDoes: The technical SEO audit crawls a target site automatically, runs 20+ technical SEO checks on every page, rolls the results into a health score (0–100), and lists issues with corresponding fixes ordered by priority. Audit history is saved, so you can compare scores and issue counts between runs.

process: In-house crawler (server-side fetching based on cheerio) retrieves page HTML
Runs 20+ rule-based checks on each page
Computes a health score weighted across checks
how.dataSource: SeeO's own crawler fetches the target site directly — no third-party data API involved

checks.items: Title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, image alt text
SSL certificate, page load, mobile readiness
Internal link structure, broken link detection

who: Site owners who need regular technical health checks
Teams verifying a redesign or migration didn't introduce regressions
Anyone taking over a new site who needs a fast baseline
limits: Full-site audits crawl up to 50 pages per run
Daily audit counts are limited by plan
Checks are rule-driven static analysis — no manual diagnosis

faqs.q: Do I need an account to audit a website?
faqs.a: The homepage offers a no-signup single-page quick audit — enter a URL and see basic checks immediately. Saving audit history, running full-site audits, and comparing history require a free account.
20+ technical SEO checks covering title tags, meta descriptions, H1 hierarchy, image alt text, canonical, SSL certificates, robots.txt, sitemap, mobile readiness, and page performance.
Two depths: quick mode audits 1 page; full mode crawls from your sitemap with a maximum of 50 pages.
Every audit produces a 0–100 health score (weighted across checks), a priority-ranked issue list with fix suggestions, and comparison against previous audits.
Yes — PDF and Excel export is included in the Pro plan.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on audit frequency?
faqs.a: Yes, audits are limited per day; the quota depends on your plan (see the pricing page).

meta.title: Rank Tracking Tool · SeeO
meta.description: Track Google keyword rankings by keyword, location, and device with SeeO. Daily automatic refreshes, history trends, and volatility alerts. Powered by SerpApi.

rankTracking.title: Keyword Rank Tracking
rankTracking.subtitle: Your real Google positions recorded automatically every day — know immediately when rankings move
rankTracking.whatItDoes: Rank tracking monitors Google search positions across four dimensions: keyword × domain × location × device. Rankings refresh automatically once a day and are written to history, so you can view a trend curve for every keyword — and get an alert whenever rankings move significantly.

how.input: A keyword list + target domain + location + device (desktop / mobile)
process: A daily scheduled job queries rankings (with controlled concurrency)
Identical parameters are cached for 24 hours to avoid duplicate calls
Each result is compared with the previous record to compute the change
Movements beyond the threshold generate an alert
output: Daily rank records and history trend curves
how.dataSource: SerpApi (Google SERP data, billed per call; SeeO adds usage counting and circuit-breaker protection)

who: Site owners who need daily data to judge optimization impact
SEO practitioners managing multi-location, multi-device rankings
Agencies reporting rank trends to clients
limits: Google only (no Bing or Baidu yet)
Manual refresh processes up to 20 keywords per request
Trackable keyword counts are limited by plan
SerpApi calls are protected by a system-level circuit breaker

faqs.q: Where does ranking data come from?
faqs.a: From SerpApi's Google search results. SeeO does not currently support Bing, Baidu, or other search engines.
Once a day via a scheduled job; you can also trigger a manual refresh on the rank tracking page — up to 20 keywords per request.

faqs.q: Can I track rankings by location and device?
faqs.a: Yes. Each keyword can specify a location and device (desktop / mobile); rankings are recorded per dimension.

faqs.q: Do repeated queries for the same keyword consume quota twice?
faqs.a: No. Queries with identical parameters (keyword + domain + location + device) reuse a 24-hour cache without calling SerpApi again.

faqs.q: Will I be notified of rank changes?
faqs.a: Yes. After each refresh, significant movements automatically generate alerts you can view in-app.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to use rank tracking?
faqs.a: Yes. Rank tracking keeps continuous history, so you need a free account to add projects and keywords.

meta.title: Backlink Analysis Tool · SeeO
meta.description: Analyze backlinks with SeeO: total backlinks, referring domains, Domain Rank, dofollow ratio, and anchor text distribution. Powered by DataForSEO. Pro plan, 7-day cache.

backlinks.title: Backlink Analysis
backlinks.subtitle: See the scale, quality, and composition of links pointing to your site
backlinks.whatItDoes: Backlink analysis pulls the link profile of a domain: total backlinks, referring domains, Domain Rank, and dofollow ratio, plus individual link details — source page, anchor text, target page, and first-seen date. Results are cached for 7 days, so you can compare across refreshes.

process: Checks the 7-day cache first — a hit returns instantly without consuming quota
On a miss, fetches backlink data from DataForSEO
A 1-hour per-domain cooldown prevents duplicate fetches
output: Total backlinks / referring domains / Domain Rank / dofollow ratio
Link details (source, anchor, target, first seen)
how.dataSource: DataForSEO backlink database (billed per call; SeeO enforces a monthly quota)

who: SEO practitioners studying competitor link profiles
Anyone monitoring link growth and loss over time
limits: Included in the Pro plan only
Per-domain data is cached for 7 days — not real-time
Monthly query quota depends on your plan

faqs.q: Where does backlink data come from?
faqs.a: From DataForSEO's backlink database. SeeO does not build its own link index; results come directly from this third-party data provider.
Backlink analysis is a Pro feature — not available on Free or Lite. See the pricing page for details.
Results per domain are cached for 7 days and served from cache during that window; after expiry, a domain can be re-fetched at most once per hour.
Total backlinks, referring domains, Domain Rank, dofollow ratio, and per-link details: source page, anchor text, target page, and first-seen date.
Yes — a monthly quota that depends on your plan. Queries pause when the quota is exhausted (see the pricing page).

docsPage.title: Product Docs
docsPage.subtitle: What SeeO is, what it can do, and where the data comes from
intro: SeeO is an SEO analytics platform that helps site owners and SEO practitioners make search optimization decisions based on real data.

The problem SeeO solves: it brings SEO workflows that usually live in separate tools — keyword research, rank tracking, technical audits, competitor analysis, backlink analysis, and content optimization — onto a single workbench, with data flowing automatically between modules instead of constant import and export.
SeeO does not build its own search index. Real-time SERP data comes from third-party APIs such as SerpApi and DataForSEO, combined with SeeO's own crawler for technical audits and content analysis.

dataSources.scope: Page HTML parsing, technical SEO checks, content analysis

faqs.q: Which search engines does SeeO support?
faqs.a: Google only for now (data via SerpApi). Bing, Baidu, and other search engines are not supported yet.
Rankings refresh automatically once a day (scheduled job). Audits run on demand with two depths: quick (1 page) and full (up to 50 pages).

SerpApi is a third-party SERP data API billed per call. SeeO enforces per-plan monthly quotas with server-side usage counting — see the pricing page for the current limits. When a quota runs out, the related features pause until it resets.
Development uses local SQLite; production runs on the Turso cloud database. Authentication is provided by Supabase Auth.
The reports center supports audit and rank reports in PDF and Excel (CSV) formats. PDF and Excel export are included in the Pro plan.

Need to check content coverage against real SERP results instead of subjective review

refundPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPage.policy: You can request a refund for a paid order. We honor full refunds for requests submitted within 7 calendar days of a successful payment; refunds are returned via the original payment method.
refundPage.process: Send a refund request including your registered email, subscription order number, and reason. Requests are processed within 3 business days and refunded via the original payment channel. Our official contact email will be published here once confirmed.
refundPage.after: After a refund is processed, the system recalculates your membership from your remaining valid orders — your plan may be downgraded accordingly, and feature access follows the new plan.
refundPage.banned: For accounts banned due to violations of the Terms of Service, see the terms regarding fees.
